summary: Laris Geardawdle seeks pure oozes across Kalimdor. His Felwood-tainted samples showed that oozes absorb and reflect their surroundings. Clean specimens may show him how they adapt to the places they inhabit.

sections.title: A Matter of Purity
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle needs clean samples for his study. The tainted ones showed how oozes take on the traits of their surroundings, but left him without a clear comparison. He seeks samples untouched by demonic taint or urban filth, so he can study ooze life on its own.

sections.title: Tracking the Primal Slime
sections.body: In Un'Goro Crater, Glutinous Oozes thrive in an isolated, primordial wilderness. Their samples give Laris the pure material he needs to study how oozes interact with Azeroth's living biomes.

faq.q: Why does Laris Geardawdle need pure ooze samples?
faq.answer: Laris's earlier specimens carried Felwood's corruption. To test his belief that slimes adapt to and reflect their surroundings, he needs pure samples from an unpolluted habitat for comparison.

faq.q: Where are the pure oozes located?
faq.answer: Glutinous Oozes live in the prehistoric wilderness of Un'Goro Crater, far south in Kalimdor.
Laris Geardawdle is a gnomish researcher in Ironforge. He is devoted to uncovering the nature of Azeroth's slimes and oozes.

faq.q: What makes oozes so interesting to researchers?
faq.answer: Oozes absorb and reflect the magical, environmental, and corruptive traits of the regions they inhabit.

faq.q: Does this follow an earlier task for Laris?
faq.answer: Yes. Laris first asked for oozes to study, but those samples carried Felwood's demonic taint. Now he seeks untarnished slimes.

faq.q: What does Laris intend to do with the samples?
faq.answer: Laris plans to compare pure samples with corrupted ones. He hopes to learn how changes in an environment affect living creatures and Azeroth's wider population.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can appreciate Laris's careful method. He isolates variables and seeks an uncontaminated control group before drawing broad conclusions.
As an Alliance adventurer, you travel from Ironforge into Kalimdor's untamed wilds to support gnomish research.
